name: Microbiology and Cell Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official pages do not state an application deadline for this program (the Graduate School says it practises rolling admissions and departments may add deadlines), a letter count, or how students are admitted, so those are left out.
summary: PhD in microbiology and cell biology at Montana State University. The program page says no GRE is required.

english.note: Graduate School minimums; many departments set higher scores, especially for applicants with assistantship funding. Pearson PTE is not accepted. Not required if you earned a bachelor's, master's or doctorate in the US or in a listed English-speaking country.

applicationFee.note: The Graduate School says the application fee will not be waived, deferred or refunded for any reason.

documents: Official transcripts to the Graduate School
Recommendation letters requested through the online application (number not stated)
requirements.note: Each admitting department sets its own application process and deadlines.

funding.note: The Graduate School's how-to-apply page says assistantships are almost always part of the offer for research degrees, and to see the program website to be sure. The program page states no stipend amount.

international.note: International applications must be complete at least 100 days before the start of the term.
